name: @eslint/jsflow
description: A fast control flow graph builder for JavaScript and TypeScript, over @eslint/jsparse's binary AST.

scripts.pretest: npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsparse && npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsscope
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsparse && npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsscope && tsc --noEmit
